target.title: [AI-assisted] feat(android): add chat command controls
target.body:
## Summary

- Problem: Android chat lacked a visible new-chat control and Gateway-backed slash-command suggestions in the composer, and the new Android New Chat entry point needed the same active-run and stale-response guards as the other chat surfaces.
- Solution: Add a header New Chat action backed by Gateway `sessions.create`, add composer slash-command suggestions backed by Gateway command metadata, gate New Chat while Android has active or queued chat work, and ignore stale `sessions.create` responses after the selected session or run state changes.
- What changed: Android now loads Gateway text commands, opens slash suggestions when the user types `/`, filters slash suggestions by command name or text alias prefix, starts new sessions with unique `New chat` labels, sends `emitCommandHooks=true` for parent-linked `sessions.create`, disables New Chat while a run or queued message is active, ignores stale New Chat responses, and includes focused Android tests plus native i18n updates.
- What did NOT change (scope boundary): Android does not request or persist `operator.admin`; admin-gated reset behavior is not part of this PR body claim. This PR does not add a persistent slash button in the composer.

## Motivation

Android users should be able to start a fresh chat and discover supported slash commands from the chat screen without relying on hidden flows or a hard-coded Android command catalog, while keeping New Chat session semantics aligned with the existing active-run safeguards.

## Change Type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [x] Feature
- [ ] Refactor required for the fix
- [ ] Docs
- [ ] Security hardening
- [ ] Chore/infra

## Scope

- [ ] Gateway / orchestration
- [ ] Skills / tool execution
- [ ] Auth / tokens
- [ ] Memory / storage
- [ ] Integrations
- [x] API / contracts
- [x] UI / DX
- [ ] CI/CD / infra

## Linked Issue/PR

- No linked issue; team-approved Android PR.
- [ ] This PR fixes a bug or regression

## Real behavior proof

- Behavior or issue addressed: Android chat exposes New Chat, `/new` starts a fresh session, slash suggestions filter by command name or alias prefix, and New Chat no longer creates or switches sessions while Android has active or queued chat work.
- Real environment tested (affected runtime/layer, not just "unit test"): Connected Android emulator running the PR `playDebug` APK against an isolated local Gateway for visible chat flows; Lenovo WSL `OpenClawUbuntu` Android unit/build proof for controller/UI guard behavior.
- Exact steps or command run after this patch:

```bash
git diff --check
pnpm native:i18n:check
./gradlew --no-daemon :app:testPlayDebugUnitTest --tests ai.openclaw.app.chat.ChatControllerCommandControlsTest --tests ai.openclaw.app.ui.chat.ChatCommandControlsTest --console=plain --stacktrace
./gradlew --no-daemon :app:assemblePlayDebug --console=plain --stacktrace
```

- Evidence after fix:

```text
git diff --check: pass
pnpm native:i18n:check: pass, entries=2363 changed=false
Focused Android unit proof: BUILD SUCCESSFUL for ChatControllerCommandControlsTest and ChatCommandControlsTest
Android playDebug assemble proof: BUILD SUCCESSFUL

Focused Android coverage locks command metadata parsing, slash prefix filtering, unique New Chat labels, parent-linked sessions.create with emitCommandHooks=true, disabled New Chat while active or queued work is present, and stale sessions.create response handling after session/run state changes.
Android emulator recordings show the header New Chat button, /new, /reset slash-command interaction, and slash command filtering in the connected app.
```

- Public artifact URLs, if screenshots/videos/files are referenced:

Header `+` creates a unique new chat session:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/15d788e5-60a9-4c4f-bef9-043800ad61d4

`/new` starts a new session:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a3bb3428-a7fb-44d3-81c9-8cf0c49e2c65

`/reset` slash-command interaction:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/19b75a73-4189-4a4a-a990-b6dccbf4c4fb

Slash command filtering:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b00ddccb-e6d7-4b1f-9df4-03a55382b2c3

- Observed result after fix: The header `+` creates a new uniquely named session when chat is idle, `/new` starts a new chat, `/reset` can be selected as a Gateway-provided slash command, slash suggestions narrow by command name or alias prefix only, and New Chat is blocked or ignored when active/queued run state would make the session switch unsafe.
- What was not tested: Full Android release build matrix and non-emulator physical-device pairing were not re-run in this phase.
- Before evidence:

```text
Prior Android chat UI did not expose these composer-level command controls or a visible new-chat action. Earlier PR heads also left the Android New Chat action available during active runs and switched to delayed sessions.create results without checking whether the selected session or run state had changed.
```

- Visual proof:
  - Before screenshot/video: Not recorded for this PR body update.
  - After screenshot/video: Public Android emulator videos linked above.
  - If not applicable, why: The visible changed behavior is represented by the linked after recordings; active-run and stale-response race guards are represented by focused Android regression tests.
- Remaining proof gap: None for the reported Android New Chat and slash-command UI behavior. Active-run and stale-response guard behavior is covered by focused Android test assertions rather than video.

## Root Cause

- Root cause: Android chat had Gateway session and command APIs available, but the UI did not expose a dedicated New Chat action or composer slash-command picker. The new Android New Chat path also needed explicit protection against active runs and delayed `sessions.create` responses.
- Missing detection / guardrail: There was no focused Android coverage for Gateway command metadata filtering, unique new-chat label creation, the parent-linked `sessions.create` hook flag, New Chat disabled state during active/queued work, or stale create-response handling.
- Contributing context (if known): Android previously depended on less discoverable chat flows and did not keep the command picker aligned with Gateway-provided command metadata or the Control UI New Chat invariants.

## Regression Test Plan

- Coverage level that should have caught this:
  - [x] Unit test
  - [ ] Seam / integration test
  - [ ] End-to-end test
  - [ ] Existing coverage already sufficient
- Target test or file: `ChatControllerCommandControlsTest` and `ChatCommandControlsTest`.
- Scenario the test should lock in: New Chat calls `sessions.create` with the selected parent session, `emitCommandHooks=true`, and a unique label only when safe; New Chat is gated while active/queued chat work exists; stale create responses do not overwrite a newer selected session; slash suggestions match command names and text aliases by prefix only.
- Why this is the smallest reliable guardrail: These tests lock the Android controller and picker behavior without needing a full Gateway or emulator run for every CI pass.
- Existing test that already covers this (if any): New focused Android tests added in this PR.
- If no new test is added, why not: Not applicable.

## User-visible / Behavior Changes

Android chat now shows a visible New Chat action and slash-command suggestions in the composer. Users can create fresh sessions from the header or via `/new`, and command suggestions come from Gateway metadata instead of an Android-local fallback catalog. Slash suggestions appear when the user types `/`; there is no permanent slash control between the attachment icon and message placeholder. New Chat is unavailable while Android is actively sending, streaming, loading, running, or has queued messages.

## Diagram

```text
Android Chat UI
  -> ChatController.refreshCommands()
  -> Gateway commands.list
  -> Slash picker opens when input starts with /
  -> Slash picker filters by command name/text alias prefix

Android Chat UI + New Chat
  -> UI disables New Chat while active/queued chat work exists
  -> ChatController.startNewChat()
  -> Capture parent session and run state
  -> Gateway sessions.create(parentSessionKey, emitCommandHooks=true, label)
  -> Ignore stale create response if selected session/run state changed
  -> New uniquely labeled session becomes selected only when still safe
```

## Security Impact

- New permissions/capabilities? No. Android does not request or persist `operator.admin` in the current PR head.
- Secrets/tokens handling changed? No.
- New/changed network calls? Yes. Android chat now calls existing Gateway `commands.list` and `sessions.create` methods from the chat surface.
- Command/tool execution surface changed? No new tool execution surface; this exposes existing text command metadata and new-session creation in Android chat.
- Data access scope changed? No broader data scope intended.
- If any `Yes`, explain risk + mitigation: The new Gateway calls use existing Gateway method contracts; reset/admin behavior is intentionally not claimed here. New Chat is gated during active/queued work and stale create responses are ignored after session/run state changes.

## Repro + Verification

### Environment

- OS: Android emulator, plus Lenovo WSL `OpenClawUbuntu` for Android build/test commands.
- Runtime/container: Android `playDebug` APK connected to an isolated local Gateway.
- Model/provider: Not model-dependent.
- Integration/channel (if any): OpenClaw Android app connected to local Gateway.
- Relevant config (redacted): Local Gateway pairing details omitted.

### Steps

1. Install the PR `playDebug` Android APK on the emulator.
2. Pair the app to the isolated local Gateway.
3. Open Chat.
4. Tap the header `+` while chat is idle and observe a unique new chat session.
5. Type `/new` and submit it.
6. Type `/reset` and submit/select the Gateway-provided slash command.
7. Type `/`, `/n`, `/mo`, `/de`, `/runtime`, and `/session` to verify slash suggestion filtering.
8. Run the focused Android controller/UI tests to verify active-run New Chat gating and stale `sessions.create` response handling.

### Expected

- New Chat creates and selects a uniquely labeled fresh session only when chat state is safe.
- `/new` starts a fresh session.
- Gateway-provided slash commands, including `/reset`, can be selected from the composer flow.
- Slash suggestions match names and aliases by prefix only.
- Description/category text does not produce matches.
- Active/queued chat work disables New Chat, and delayed create responses do not overwrite a newer selected session.

### Actual

- Matches expected behavior in focused Android tests and linked emulator recordings.

## Evidence

- [ ] Failing test/log before + passing after
- [ ] Trace/log snippets
- [x] Screenshot/recording
- [ ] Perf numbers (if relevant)

```text
Focused Android tests:
- ChatControllerCommandControlsTest
- ChatCommandControlsTest

Build/proof commands reported for this PR:
- git diff --check
- pnpm native:i18n:check
- ./gradlew --no-daemon :app:testPlayDebugUnitTest --tests ai.openclaw.app.chat.ChatControllerCommandControlsTest --tests ai.openclaw.app.ui.chat.ChatCommandControlsTest --console=plain --stacktrace
- ./gradlew --no-daemon :app:assemblePlayDebug --console=plain --stacktrace

Latest source guards added after review:
- ChatControllerCommandControlsTest asserts the parent-linked sessions.create payload includes emitCommandHooks=true.
- ChatControllerCommandControlsTest asserts stale New Chat responses do not switch away after the active session changes.
- ChatCommandControlsTest asserts New Chat is disabled while active or queued chat work exists.

Public Android emulator recordings are linked in Real behavior proof.
```

## Human Verification

- Verified scenarios: Header New Chat creates a unique session; `/new` starts a new session; `/reset` slash-command interaction is recorded; slash command filtering narrows by name or alias prefix.
- Edge cases checked: `/` lists commands, `/n` matches `/new`, `/mo` matches `/model`, `/de` matches alias `/delegate` for `/agent`, `/runtime` and `/session` do not match description/category text, and the composer does not show a permanent slash control.
- What you did **not** verify: Full Android release matrix, physical device pairing, admin-gated reset behavior, or a live visual recording of the active-run race guard.

## Review Conversations

- [ ] I replied to or resolved every bot review conversation I addressed in this PR.
- [x] I left unresolved only the conversations that still need reviewer or maintainer judgment.

## Compatibility / Migration

- Backward compatible? Yes.
- Config/env changes? No.
- Migration needed? No.
- If yes, exact upgrade steps: Not applicable.

## Risks and Mitigations

- Risk: Gateway command metadata could include commands Android should not present.
  - Mitigation: Android displays Gateway-provided text command metadata and filters only by command name/text alias prefix; admin-gated reset behavior is not claimed by this PR body.
- Risk: Session labels could collide when multiple New Chat sessions exist.
  - Mitigation: The controller chooses the next available `New chat`, `New chat 2`, `New chat 3`, etc. label and has focused test coverage.
- Risk: Parent-linked New Chat could skip Gateway lifecycle hooks.
  - Mitigation: Android sends `emitCommandHooks=true` in the parent-linked `sessions.create` payload and has focused test coverage for that contract.
- Risk: New Chat could switch away while an active run or delayed create response still belongs to a different session.
  - Mitigation: Android gates New Chat while active/queued chat work exists and ignores stale `sessions.create` responses after the selected session or run state changes.
